faqs.question: What is generative engine optimization (GEO)?
faqs.answer: GEO means making your content easy for AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google's AI Overviews to find, trust and quote when they write an answer.

faqs.question: What is the difference between GEO, AEO and SEO?
faqs.answer: SEO gets your pages into search indexes and normal results. AEO (answer engine optimization) makes each answer on a page easy to lift. GEO makes AI tools trust your business enough to name or cite it in their answers.

faqs.question: Is GEO replacing SEO?
faqs.answer: No. Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode are built on Google's normal index, and ChatGPT and Copilot use search indexes including Bing. Good SEO is the foundation; GEO adds entity consistency, answer-first writing and mentions on other websites.

faqs.question: How do I get my business mentioned in ChatGPT?
faqs.answer: Allow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt, get indexed in Bing, use one consistent business description everywhere, write answer-first pages with specific facts, and get listed and reviewed on the third-party sites that ChatGPT already cites for your topic.

faqs.question: Do I need special schema for AI Overviews?
faqs.answer: Google says no special markup is needed. Organization, Article, FAQPage and Service schema still help systems read your pages correctly, as long as the markup matches what is visible.

faqs.question: Does llms.txt help with AI search?
faqs.answer: It is optional. llms.txt is a proposed summary file for AI tools; Google has said it does not use it, and there is little evidence other tools rely on it yet.

faqs.question: How can I measure AI visibility for free?
faqs.answer: Check 20 customer prompts monthly in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot, track referrals from chatgpt.com and perplexity.ai in Google Analytics 4, and watch impressions on question-style queries in Google Search Console.

faqs.question: How long does GEO take to work?
faqs.answer: Months rather than days. Indexing, mentions on other sites and trust build over time, so measure monthly.
